purpose: Define one fractal, question-routed Terrain navigation contract over typed source lattices so humans and AI companions can traverse inward, outward, laterally, temporally and across proof maps without loading a whole world or reducing every relationship to one universal graph.

terrainDimensions.view: which domain of truth is projected
terrainDimensions.lens: for whom the same truth is explained
terrainDimensions.mapMode: which spatial/question grammar expresses the relationships
terrainDimensions.level: how much semantic depth is visible
terrainDimensions.contextProfile: which bounded context fields are projected
terrainDimensions.journey: why the reader or model arrived here

mapModes.RADIAL: what relates to the focal anchor
mapModes.CLUSTER: what belongs together and which container can be entered
mapModes.TIMELINE_JOURNEY: what happened before/after and how meaning evolved

bands.D1_DIRECT: immediately implicated relationships, contained/containing context and strongest routes
bands.D2_NEAR: supporting neighborhood likely to answer or disambiguate
bands.D3_BOUNDARY: peripheral context and explicit continuation routes

rules: Three bands beyond current are a default visibility/retrieval budget, not a universal ontology.
Semantic distance is not pixel distance.
Semantic distance is not raw graph-hop count.
Human pins and explicit current work may alter projection relevance without mutating canonical relationships.

fractalNode.rule: A stable node may be a leaf in one projection and an enterable container in another.

resolver.name: ResolveTerrainNeighborhood
rules: Resolver may fetch several implicated layers in one deterministic operation.
Node cards are bounded context projections, not entire underlying corpora.
Cross-lattice relationships retain their source lattice and relation type.
Coverage boundaries and excluded scope are first-class output.
Unknown, stale and contradictory states remain visible.

contextLeaseBehavior.onInward: retain breadcrumbs/outward routes, replace broad child detail with selected cluster and bounded destination neighborhood
contextLeaseBehavior.onLateral: retain journey reason and minimum shared boundary context, replace unrelated previous payload with destination neighborhood
contextLeaseBehavior.onOutward: restore bounded parent envelope and retain the exited child relationship as journey context

candidateStableNavigationReflexes: start from a verified current anchor
peek a bounded neighborhood before choosing descent
follow typed owner and source routes
reorient when a question crosses coverage boundaries
stop when current question obligations are satisfied
preserve journey reason and return route
trainingBoundary.rule: Weights may learn how to navigate; source lattices own what exists now; the context compiler decides what to load now.

scaleRule.localCostMustNotDependOn: global world cardinality through full scans

awarenessComposition.semanticAxes: OUTWARD <-> CURRENT <-> INWARD + LATERAL + CROSS_LATTICE + TEMPORAL + SOURCE
